mainEntity.name: What should I do when AI creates a terrible digital product draft?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If AI produces a weak first draft, do not simply ask for more words. Diagnose the failure: unclear audience, incomplete source material, vague instructions, wrong format, unsupported claims, or unrealistic scope. Then revise the brief and regenerate only the affected section.

**Context:** Run My AI Biz presents master prompts as adaptable instructions that require business context, review, and refinement. Prompt quality alone cannot correct missing expertise or unreliable sources.

**Key factors:**
- The desired customer outcome
- Specific examples and constraints
- Reliable reference material
- A measurable quality standard

**Practical guidance:** Give AI one task at a time, include a model of the expected structure, and request a critique before rewriting. Preserve useful human edits instead of replacing the entire document after every revision.

Run My AI Biz encourages iterative, owner-directed workflows rather than blind regeneration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Find the cause before regenerating: unclear audience, weak sources, vague instructions, unsuitable format, or excessive scope. Tighten the brief, provide examples and constraints, revise one section at a time, and preserve useful human edits.
